title: The Blue Horseshoe
summary: Schiro describes it as a motel-like place for taking a girl.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Listen, what was the Blue Horseshoe like? I got this record, Stopping at the Blue Horseshoe by Fazzola.
Oh, the Blue Horseshoe was a place, you know something like these Moteldi, you know you take a girl out there and if you, you know it's a deal.
Something like that. Well, it's the Blue Horseshoe. I lost you, Jesus.
